pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a "Lieblingszimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. a big room
   B. a cold room
   C. a new room
   D. a favourite room

2. Which German word means "warm"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. nass
   B. neblig
   C. wolkig
   D. warm

3. Which German word means "in"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. neben
   B. unter
   C. in
   D. vor

4. What is the plural of "das Ei"? (1 mark)
   A. die Eien
   B. die Eie
   C. die Eis
   D. die Eier

5. Which little word goes with the noun "Wolke"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. der
   C. die
   D. das

6. What does "dort" mean? (1 mark)
   A. now
   B. there
   C. always
   D. here

7. What does "der Zucker" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. watermelon
   B. cabbage or kale
   C. sugar
   D. maize

8. What is the plural of "der Fuß"? (1 mark)
   A. die Fuße
   B. die Fußen
   C. die Füß
   D. die Füße

9. Which German word or phrase means "candle"? (1 mark)
   A. die Party
   B. der Kuchen
   C. die Kerze
   D. das Lied

10. Which completes "Die Katze sitzt ___ dem Tisch" (under)? (1 mark)
   A. unter
   B. vor
   C. auf
   D. über

11. Which German word or phrase means "fork"? (1 mark)
   A. das Zimmer
   B. das Wohnzimmer
   C. die Küche
   D. die Gabel

12. What does "Wie heißt du?" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name?
   B. please
   C. see you soon
   D. sorry, excuse me

13. What does "die Woche" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Thursday
   C. Wednesday
   D. week

14. Which German word is the number 1? (1 mark)
   A. elf
   B. fünf
   C. zehn
   D. eins

15. What does "der Kuchen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. present
   B. candle
   C. cake
   D. party

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the German words with der, die or das for: eye, neck, friend, uncle. (4 marks)

17. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bedroom, chair, window, watermelon. (4 marks)

18. Write the German words with der, die or das for: pot, face, father, grandmother. (4 marks)

19. Write the German names of these months: July, August, September. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — a favourite room
   Liebling means favourite and Zimmer means room.

2. D — warm
   warm in German is warm.

3. C — in
   in in German is in.

4. D — die Eier
   The plural of das Ei is die Eier.

5. C — die
   It is die Wolke, so the little word is die.

6. B — there
   dort means there.

7. C — sugar
   der Zucker means sugar.

8. D — die Füße
   The plural of der Fuß is die Füße.

9. C — die Kerze
   candle in German is die Kerze.

10. A — unter
   unter means under.

11. D — die Gabel
   fork in German is die Gabel.

12. A — What is your name?
   Wie heißt du? means What is your name?.

13. D — week
   die Woche means week.

14. D — eins
   1 in German is eins.

15. C — cake
   der Kuchen means cake.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Auge, der Hals, der Freund, der Onkel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Schlafzimmer, der Stuhl, das Fenster, die Wassermelone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Topf, das Gesicht, der Vater, die Oma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Juli, August, September.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.
